notes.title: The patch 1.1.2 has come...
notes.content:
[h2]Hello fellow survivors! [/h2]

There has been a lot of feedback coming from you through all of our channels. We can see a great interest in Help Will Come Tomorrow - you shared some creative ideas for the game’s expansion, reported issues, shared your positive impressions. Thank you so much for talking to us and appreciating the game with many positive Steam reviews!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662047/19adda4fc46b12014e90802f878f559a62f60103.jpg[/img]

[h3]In this update we come with the next portion of fixes, PATCH 1.1.2:[/h3]
- Fixed an issue with cut off text in the map’s danger level information window (russian language version);
- Fixed the unattainable achievements “Help did come!” and “No man left behind” in the “Shatun” scenario;
- Fixed the freezing dialogue “One hundred Imperials”;
- Fixed an issue appearing in “Shatun” dialogue.



[h3]We also updated the link to our DISCORD channel, which was recently moved to a new server.[/h3]
Please make sure you follow us in the new space, click below to get redirected:
[url=https://discord.gg/ap3qYZbT34][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662047/5cac55339c7ecf57b2da9de8841f2d0a7126a80f.gif[/img][/url]

We would be delighted to engage even more in chat with you. Moreover, it’s the best place to get an instant reply or follow the updates not only for Help Will Come Tomorrow, but for other similar games, Klabater projects and hear from the Arclight Creations team.

Thank you for staying with us and good luck with the survival next time.

Klabater Publishing and Arclight Creations

notes.title: New Community Tools!
notes.content:
Dear Survivors!

Long time no hear! We have significantly exciting news for you today ːsteamhappyː

As promised some time ago, we may happily confirm that from now on we have added Steam community tools for your cheerful joy and amusement! Among them are unique:
[list]
[*] badges,
[*] trading cards,
[*] profile backgrounds
[*] emoticons
[/list]
So, from now on you are not only survivors but real pathfinders and gatherers. You find things others can’t, that is just what you do. And now you can trade those things, or even present it to other survivors in the camp!

[b]Arclight and Klabater team[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 has landed with NEW SCENARIO!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[b]We are happy to tell you that with this update, we can deliver another alternative scenario![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662047/96b892c0fa0780d71a37945d49af380d877ff38f.png[/img]

We read your reviews and discussions very carefully, both on the forums and Discord. One thing you paid particular attention to was the desire to know the fates of our heroes. In this update, other than a dedicated outro for every ending, you will learn how did the events in Taiga influence the heroes and what was their ultimate fate. We hope these changes and additions will be to your liking.

Once again, we would like to thank you for all comments and reviews :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662047/3595017f1c7e9f2b36aa3bb01d6a3ed79c138d0b.jpg[/img]

1.1.1 Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Added a new scenario with an alternative ending - "Shatun"
[*] Added summaries with heroes' fates after finishing the game with a positive resolution
[*] Added personalized icons for each marker on the map
[*] Fixed an issue with inactive escape dialogue option in "The cavalry has arrived" event
[*] Fixed unresponsive buttons that could appear during some events when screen resolution was set to 4:3
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the game to freeze during the 23rd day in a "The Final Showdown" scenario while playing on "Resident of Syberia" difficulty level
[*] Completely new RU localization
[/list]

[b]Thank you for your constant support! 

Arclight Creations & Klabater Team[/b]

notes.title: HELIBORNE: ENHANCED EDITION AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

[i]Heliborne[/i] is one of the most successful Klabater's releases. Initially released in 2017, it remains one of the publisher’s flagships. Today we would love to let you know that the game just debuted in its ultimate shape!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/b679693ecfa085b455b2ba8cff0639dc9f29d810.jpg[/img]

[i]Heliborne[/i], the Ultimate Helicopter Warfare Experience, is now taken to new heights as the game officially becomes [b][i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i][/b]! The game’s definitive edition brings not only tons of improvement and new content but also debuts at a new price (29,99 USD/EUR) for both the game and all DLCs included! 

--> Heliborne: Enhanced Edition [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433530/Heliborne/]Steam Card[/url]
--> WATCH HELIBORNE ENHANCED EDITION[url=https://youtu.be/28X5Dn9Zw-0] TRAILER[/url]

[b]Klabater decided that all the gamers who already paid for the original edition will now receive Enhanced Edition and ALL DLCs for free[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/67427e0114be9e46650b7dd2044510f40ded0839.jpg[/img]

[i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i] is the next big step for the franchise, meant as a final version of the [i]Heliborne[/i] game dedicated to those who love the game already but also for newcomers. It’s a brand new visual quality mixed with significant gameplay overhaul. The development team is now working on the console edition of Enhanced Edition, and more info will be revealed soon!

With [i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i], the Ultimate PC Helicopter Warfare Experience is now taken to new heights! 
[list]
[*] New Prototype Machines 
[*] Fully Upgraded Game Engine 
[*] New Day & Night Maps 
[*] Updated in-game Physics 
[*] Empowered Multiplayer Experience 
[*] Refreshed User Interface
[/list]
[b]As we promised to our community, all who have bought the game before will get the free update to Enhanced Edition! This is our way of saying thank you’ to all the community that helped us and supported us for years. So, even if you own the basic version of the game with no DLC installed, you will still get access to both the Enhanced Edition of the game and ALL DLCs released until now! Enjoy![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/8df5edc6ebc48de7fbfd170c2c503e9d1c54e615.jpg[/img]
[b]WHAT’S IN IT FOR THE PLAYERS?[/b]

With Heliborne: Enhanced Edition players get the basic game and over a dozen of cool DLC at a very, very reasonable price. A summary of a player’s ‘savings’ below:
[list]
[*] The previous Heliborne price was 19,99 USD/EUR, and DLCs were altogether worth   54,85 USD/EUR... So, until now, the whole package cost 75 USD/EUR.
[*] From August 20, the 75 USD/EUR value content will be priced at 29,99 USD/EUR... As simple as that! You get EVERYTHING at once, and [b]you SAVE 60%[/b]!

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1! Characters chilling balance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662047/d9a27e1d9fe8bce8f5dc4e79a3d6d0bf48c5a56c.jpg[/img]

Thank you very much for all the previous comments! They are extremely useful and help us improve the game so that it is the best experience for you. Of course, we will continue to improve the game and we hope you enjoy all the changes.

If you still have any questions or suggestions we are on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1119600/discussions/]the forum[/url] and [url=klabater.com/discord]Discord channel[/url] for you!

We have also created a [url=https://helpwillcometomorrow.fandom.com/]wiki fandom[/url] that can be supplemented! What's more, we plan to put a tip menu in the diary section detailing the calculations and mechanics.

[b]Changelog for patch 1.0.1:[/b]
- Changes in item descriptions, recipes, and statuses to make their mechanics clearer
- Increasing tool modifiers when acquiring resources and implementing recipes using them
- Addition of an information window on the level of chilling of the character and showing accurate information on how the chill status will change at the end of the turn, with the current level of campfire, camp upgrades, and character's clothes.
- Increased strength of items that lower the character's cooling down
- Corrections of some language errors in all language versions
- Bugfix amputation recipes - blocking the option of assigning an unconscious person as a guardian.
- Tutorial corrections - the step with giving the character water has been made clear
- Tutorial correction - step with assigning characters to work - possible change of characters, which eliminates the bug from blocking the tutorial
- Adding a renegade marker to the visibility bar if it is nearby
- Fix with the playing of the invalid outro
- Addition of an additional condition to avoid the "Timber!" event
- Increase the chance of finding a place to fish on river tiles from 33% to 66% each time you enter with a fishing rod or harpoon.
- Improved event triggering with signallers if there is an animal or renegade on the tile with the quest
- Added option to disable the animation of text writing in balloons in the game settings
- Fixed Survival Master achievement being obtained too early
- Game balance, including item effects
- Fixed an event with Dmitry's Quest


[b]Some tips & FAQ:[/b]

    TIP 1 - Picking items from the inventory: In addition to dragging resources onto characters to feed or drink them, there is the option of distributing the resource in groups. To do this, click on an item from the inventory and it will stick to your cursor. If you have more of a given resource, e.g. water, you can give it to several characters at once by clicking on their silhouettes in the location. Then there is no need to consult the inventory each time to allocate the same resource. To disconnect the resource from the cursor, right-click.

TIP 2 - Setting up traps: If you want to set up a trap on the map, you must take it with you on an expedition. There are several zones on the map where small animals occur (they are suggested by the names of areas or resources that we can get there). If you have a trap with you and enter such a zone, an event with the option of setting the trap will automatically start. When you do this, a trap marker will appear on the map. After the next visit to this tile, when performing a search action, you have the chance to find an animal in the zone's resources. this patch we've added even more hints in the descriptions of the traps in which zones may be located.

TIP 3 - Fishing: To trigger a fishing event - go to the river tile with a harpoon or fishing rod. Each time you enter a tile with water, there is a chance that the character will find a good fishing spot. When this is done, the fishing event will automatically be triggered. In the patch, we increased the chance of triggering it from 33% to 66%. You can also use the event to search for a tile with a river.
